about: drive-wheel's four-bevel differential cluster (V1 ~/src/jscad/drive-wheel/drive-wheel.jscad gearTrain: base, drive, antidrive, top — four 32T bevels, circularPitch pi*50/32, clearance 0.05, V1 backlash 0.05) rebuilt from two gear.bevelPair document lines and one 180-degree turn, with no hand-tuned offset. V1 placed the same four gears with rotateY(+-90/180) and snap(..., +-addendum). moduleMm = 50/32; backlashMm = 2 * 0.05 / cos(20 deg) (call 4's V1 conversion). The pair's own part names are drive/pinion; `gears` maps them to drive-wheel's. TODO/core-046; docs-021 ships it as the worked example.
